TOLUWANISINGS : LESSONS YOU AND I MUST LEARN ABOUT HIM.

October 25, 2026 4 min read Latunde Akin

TOLUWANISINGS : LESSONS YOU AND I MUST LEARN ABOUT HIM.
By Latunde Akin
I can't believe there are many Christian believers that still doesn't believe life is a battlefield and that after experiencing salvation in Christ,you still have a lot of battle to fight against your former foundation from your bloodline. Every believer should know they have work to do.
I heard TOLUWANISINGS on interview with a nollywood actress stating categorically that he doesn't believe in fighting battles or singing about battle against evil than only to worship God.
I actually understand him so well and I agreed with him about being focused of worshiping and singing about the finished work of Christ.
What I personally discovered in the interview was just that he seemed to neglect the need to fight battles. Leaving battles aside for God to fight is good but we are the one God will still use to do it. God expected us to fight it squarely so he can help us with His power.
Secondly a lot believed he was 41 years old,later to discover he was 34 year. I don't personally know how such wrong narrative emerged into the public but this is what I think happened. He probably lived mature than his age and people around him thought there are things he had known. Else they would have taught him how to handle things better.
His mother demised when he was six month. He lived and was catered for by his mother's sibling. He never enjoyed parental upbringing. So there wasn't so much connection between him and his biological father.
Much more his father is still a Muslim,likewise his direct family from his father's house. He built the first house,second house and God lifted him into limelight. Definitely and certainly,those unbelieving people from his house will want to start a spiritual battle against him. Apart from the one he will face for the fame or from outside.
"Bi ogun ile koba jani,tode ko le pani". If battle from inside isn't fighting you,battle from outside can't succeed "
For every believer,I always advise that we must always be battle ready. We must understand that success doesn't mean battle is over. Salvation in Christ doesn't mean battle is over. The finished work of Jesus doesn't mean we must be ignorant of the devices of the devil.
Toluwanisings didn't die at a ripe age we all expect and this brings about many concerns to a lot of people. We may say God knows the best but we still know it's not normal.
Health wise every person must always be sensitive to what their health is saying. Do get checked up often and monitor your blood pressure always. We shouldn't totally spiritualise matters when it's purely medical ignorance because of work work and work.
I can still tell you your need and assignment as a believer is to first face and fight the battery from your father's house on your knees every night before or after any success in your life. If you don't,they may come back to hunt at a time you least expected. And they do this in collaboration with the public or people from the outside. So you won't suspect where is the source of the trouble is coming from. You will be pointing hand towards people you met at work,church,neighbours outside ,when the real source is from your ignored background or foundation. They only collaborated.
In a bit to help a lot of people maintain consistent prayer life. We have set up a 1 hour prayer time on telegram group (not intercessory group). Where we all pray together every night and fight our battles together. The time is 11pm to 12am every day.
AND WE HAVE STARTED THIS SINCE 767 days ago. Which means we are 767 days into it already. We chose 11pm to 12am because there is power in night prayers. Any decisions any evil personalities are making against anyone,it's that time we dismantle them everyday. And as we break into 12 am which is when everyday begins,we began prophesying over the day.
There is power in consistency. You don't have to spend long hours praying. 1 hour every night is power. We pray on just one prayer theme for a week. Your battles can't survive it. Join us through the channel in pinned in the comment section.
May the Lord sustain Toluwanisings wife and children. May they live to fulfill God's plan.
May we all arise and fulfill God's assignment to pray in Jesus name. Amen
